reading.title: Rosie the Rabbit
reading.purpose: Follow a rabbit through a day in her field.
paras: Rosie the rabbit lives in a burrow. The field is her habitat. A bird has a nest in the tall grass.
One day, a hawk flies over the field. Hawks hunt in the daytime. Rosie hops into her burrow. It is a good shelter and will protect her.

qs.q: A habitat is the place where an animal lives. What is Rosie's habitat?
qs.why: The reading says the field is her habitat.

qs.q: What does Rosie do when the hawk flies over?
qs.why: Rosie hops into her burrow, where she is safe.

qs.q: Why is the burrow a good shelter?
qs.why: The reading says the burrow will protect Rosie.

needsReview.reason: A hawk hunting is true to nature but could unsettle a sensitive child; Rosie stays safe. Confirm the tone suits the room.
